versions.title: Second art pass: double resolution
versions.author: Claude, after Netanel's review
versions.notes: Fixed: arms, work and eating now happen in front of the body (they were done with the back). Sleeps lying down. Legs with knees, and the body rises as the legs pass, so the walk no longer looks like a dance. Twice the resolution: finer pixels and thin outlines. A smoother walk. When idle, a thought cloud (different from the speech bubble). More colour variety between individuals.

versions.title: Echofolk — detailed sketch
versions.author: Ariel

media.label: Sketch: body, legs and claws, ear & drum, mouth options
Colour reference: an iridescent leaf beetle

versions.notes: The shell should shift like a rainbow leaf beetle: dark green, light green and purple depending on the angle. The mouth runs around the body on a belt; Ariel prefers a mouth that travels along the belt and dilates open like an iris (rather than tooth-like plates), so the three hands can put things in from any side. No eyes: echolocation from a tufted hammer that vibrates, a dish that listens and a resonance box (drum) that amplifies. The hammer winds up and releases in one strike, then has to recharge — a possible limitation.
